# Game rule gates
FNKX_formables_enabled = {
	NOT = { has_game_rule = { rule = FNKX_formables_rule option = DISABLED } }
	OR = {
		is_ai = no
		NOT = { has_game_rule = { rule = FNKX_formables_ai_rule option = PLAYERS_ONLY } }
	}
}

FNKX_regional_eligibility = {
	has_game_rule = { rule = FNKX_formables_rule option = REGIONAL }
}

# Country scope: may proclaim a new nation right now
FNKX_can_form_nation = {
	is_subject = no
	has_capitulated = no
	has_civil_war = no
}

# State scope: owned and controlled by ROOT, or by one of ROOT's subjects
FNKX_held_by_ROOT = {
	custom_trigger_tooltip = {
		tooltip = FNKX_held_by_ROOT_tt
		OR = {
			is_owned_and_controlled_by = ROOT
			AND = {
				owner = { is_subject_of = ROOT }
				controller = {
					OR = {
						tag = ROOT
						is_subject_of = ROOT
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}
}
